headword: {相性|あいしょう}が{悪|わる}い

definitions.gloss: incompatible; don't get along; not a good match
definitions.explanation: Describes people, things, or situations that do not work well together. Used for interpersonal relationships, food combinations, technology compatibility, and more.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{相性|あいしょう}が{悪|わる}い。
examples.english: Those two don't get along well.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ソフト→ソフト：01532_sofuto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧うち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦パソコン→パソコン：01538_pasokon⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{相性|あいしょう}が{悪|わる}い⟦みたい→みたい：10755_mitai⟧だ。
examples.english: This software doesn't seem to be compatible with our computer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{相性|あいしょう}が{悪|わる}くて⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦ストレス→ストレス：03827_sutoresu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じている→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{仕方|しかた}→仕方：01603_shikata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I don't get along with my boss and feel stressed every day, but since it's work, there's nothing I can do.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{相性|あいしょう}→相性：13654_aishou⟧ (compatibility, chemistry) + ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ + ⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (bad). The opposite is ⟦{相性|あいしょう}→相性：13654_aishou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{良|い}い/⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧ (compatible, a good match). This expression is very versatile and used beyond just people — it describes any pairing that doesn't work well.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- A⟦と→と：00512_to⟧B⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{相性|あいしょう}が{悪|わる}い: A and B are incompatible
- {相性|あいしょう}が{悪|わる}い⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧: to feel incompatible with

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{相性|あいしょう}が{悪|わる}い: not getting along with someone
- {食|た}べ{合|あ}わせ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{相性|あいしょう}が{悪|わる}い: food combination that doesn't go well together
- ⟦{機器|きき}→機器：13180_kiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{相性|あいしょう}が{悪|わる}い: hardware/device incompatibility

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{合|あ}わない→合う：10466_au⟧: doesn't suit, doesn't match — more casual
- ⟦{馬|うま}→馬：01865_uma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}わない→合う：10466_au⟧: don't hit it off — specifically about interpersonal chemistry
- ⟦{不向|ふむ}き→不向き：11388_fumuki⟧: unsuited — focuses on suitability rather than mutual chemistry
